member.name: T:ErpBridge.RemoteApi.Http.HttpRemoteApiClient
member.summary:
Default implementation. Uses a Polly-protected and System.Text.Json for (de)serialization.
All five endpoints defined in docs/api-contracts.md are bound here: - POST /api/v1/licenses/validate - GET /api/v1/jobs/pending - POST /api/v1/jobs/ack - POST /api/v1/bootstrap - POST /api/v1/agents/heartbeat
Per the contract, every POST carries an Idempotency-Key header so a retried request after a network blip is not interpreted as a new operation by the central API. For the key is the job id (the natural unit of work). For other POSTs the key is generated per call.
